comment: No module in this plugin calls appendContextMenu, so there are no menu lines to write; the right-click menu carries only Rack's own items. Checked against the maker's source, which matches the installed 2.0.0. Knob defaults read from configParam: Tesseract's six rotation knobs default to 0, which is why it sits still when first added; The Bifurcator and Ikeda default their clock knob to 2, so both run on their own. No display in the plugin handles a click or a drag.
